repos_data.description: Go http.Client with a byte-exact browser TLS fingerprint (uTLS) — survive JA3/JA4 blocking without a headless browser.

A keyless web reader for AI agents. When a fetch hits a bot wall or a page that only renders in a browser, searchts tries a plain fetch, then a relay, then a real browser, and says plainly when it can't. MCP server, CLI, and Python library.
